criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One dark list panel sits under the header with every batch on its own line — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, all on the page at once.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the board — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigating away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER, just as the drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list starts at y=71, right under the header that ends at y=51 — nothing between them, exactly as drawn.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The input runs from x=20 and the ADD BATCH button sits to its right at x=1293, on the same row — as the drawing shows.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has a mix-ratio status line in orange sitting beneath the add row; it isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.
Your own test for this ran and went red — the batches were gone after a restart.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen shows an export, and your test suite says nothing about CSV — the run only covers the header and a restart, so I could not check this.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: a status line beneath the add row, in orange, showing the current mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches you added to still be there after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the batches were gone

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There's a 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call too.
No console errors on the page.
summary: The board itself looks right, captain: the orange GROUT TRACKER header, the batch list directly beneath it, and an input with ADD BATCH to its right all match your drawing. Two things fall short — the mix-ratio status line you drew beneath the add row isn't there at all, and your own test for batches surviving a restart ran and failed, the list coming back empty. The CSV export makes no visual claim and no test covers it, so I couldn't check it.
